hero.intro: Hi, I'm Santhosh, a full stack engineer with 7+ years shipping React, Node.js and TypeScript products. I help businesses turn messy processes into fast, reliable software.

process.title: Discover
process.body: A short call to understand your goals, users and budget. You get a clear scope, timeline and estimate before any work starts.

process.title: Design & build
process.body: I share regular progress on a live preview link, so you see the product take shape and can steer early.

process.title: Launch
process.body: Testing on real devices, speed and SEO checks, then a smooth go-live on your domain.

process.title: Support
process.body: A handover walkthrough, and I stay available for fixes, new features and growth.
